title: 063 Vez strazni
prompt: Low-angle shot of a tall square stone watchtower standing on the edge of a cliff above a working stone quarry at its foot, braziers burning on top of the tower, wooden cranes and cut stone blocks in the quarry below, wagons on a path, early morning amber mist rising from the valley. No people. Palette: amber morning light, warm mist, grey stone, dark rock silhouettes, no teal. No text.

title: 089 Architekt
prompt: Painterly medium-wide shot of one master architect, a lean middle-aged man with a short dark beard and a long brown coat, standing at a wooden drafting table on a rocky ledge above a stone quarry, a large compass in his hand, plans pinned down by stones and fluttering in the wind, below him a new castle wall rising beside the quarry with cranes, golden late-afternoon light. Loose expressive brushstrokes, not photorealistic, not a close-up. Palette: golden light, ochre, pale stone, brown coat, no teal. No text.

title: 090 Rozsireni tezby
prompt: Aerial view of a huge stone quarry being expanded: deep terraced pits of pale stone with new terraces freshly cut into the hillside, two brand-new quarry pits opening beside the old one, many wooden cranes, ramps, ladders and ox wagons carrying blocks, clouds of stone dust, warm hazy afternoon sun. No visible faces. Palette: warm ochre, sand, pale cream stone, golden haze, no teal. No text.
